entities.text:
Vesireddy Prabhakar Reddy And 14 Ors., vs Rev. Land Acq.
Dept
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed with the following prayer;
"to issue order or direction more particularly Writ of Mandamus to declare the action of the respondents in not initiating Land Acquisition proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act and not paying the compensation for the land situated in Sy.Nos.171,
172, 162 and 163 of B.Vellamla Village, Narketpally Mandal, Nalgonda District, as illegal and violation of Articles 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents to initiate the Land Acquisition proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act and pay the compensation to the petitioners' land situated in Sy. Nos.171, 172, 162 and 163 of B Vellamla Village, Narketpally Mandal,
Nalgonda District".

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and CAD.
3.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are owners and possessors of various situated at B. Vellamla Revenue Village, Narketpally Mandal.

In the year, 2006-07 under the guise of executing works under National Rural Employment SK, J Guarantee Scheme, 2005, bund of Nalla Cheruvu in the village was raised in the patta land of the said survey numbers and as per the certificate issued by the Tahsildar, Narketpally vide proceedings No.B/7379/09 dated 07.10.2009,
the land in the said Survey numbers got submerged in the tank due to raising of the bund.

entities.text: National Rural Employment SK, J Guarantee Scheme, 2005
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that though the petitioners submitted a representation on 15.10.2009, no action has been taken by the respondents.

He further submits that in view of raising of the bund, the patta land of the petitioners got submerged and it has become unused, thereby the petitioners'
livelihood is affected and as such, the petitioners are entitled for compensation under the Land Acquisition Act and requested to allow the writ petition.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Irrigation and CAD based on the counter averments submits that the patta lands in Sy.Nos.171, 172, 162 SK, J and 163 are not submerged after execution Vesireddy Prabhakar Reddy And 14 Ors., vs Rev. Land Acq. Dept., Rep. By Its Prl. ... on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193879218/
1 of NREGS work and moreover the Irrigation Department has not given any requisition for requirement of the said land.

entities.text: Vesireddy Prabhakar Reddy And 14 Ors., vs Rev. Land Acq. Dept
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that as per the records, Nalla Cheruvu is Panchayat Raj tank and strengthening the bund only but not raising the weir and as such the extra land will not be submerged.

He further submits that in the absence of Irrigation Department, the Tahsildar,
Narketpally, issued the certificate about submerging the lands in the said survey numbers and the Irrigation Department did not take up any new construction or repair work such as raising of surplus weir and the extra land will not be submerged and requested to dismiss the writ petition.
5.

Having heard the submissions and perusal of the record, this Court is of the considered view that as per the counter of the respondent No.6, the respondents are disputing the certificate issued by the Tahsildar vide proceedings No.B/7379/09 dated 07.10.2009 on SK, J the ground that without issuing notice to the authorities of Irrigation Department, the respondent No.4 has conducted survey and issued the said certificate.

6. In view of the above, without going into the merits of the matter, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondent No.2 to conduct survey of the subject land with the assistance of the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records in the presence of the petitioners as well as the Officers of the Irrigation Department.

If the survey reveals that the land of the petitioners is submerged in Nalla Cheruvu, the respondents are directed to initiate the land acquisition proceedings and pay compensation to the petitioners and the entire exercise shall be completed within four (4) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
